preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 50 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string s in the test cases must have a length between 1 and 50.
Each string s must consist only of the capital letters 'A', 'B', and 'C'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if (count_A + count_C) % 2 == 0 and count_B >= count_A and count_B >= count_C else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if the total count of 'A' and 'C' is even and the count of 'B' is at least the count of 'A' and 'C'; otherwise, it must be 'NO'.
